title: Fish oil: does it help you build muscle? 🐟
caption:
For muscle growth the evidence is mixed; some studies show a little less soreness. Its strongest case is your heart. Do you take fish oil? 👇

General information, not medical advice.

Supplement Series, Part 5
first_comment: Fish oil or oily fish: which do you go for? 🐟
sources: Rossato LT et al. Benefits of omega-3 supplementation on muscle mass and strength in older adults: a systematic review. Clin Nutr ESPEN 2020;37:10-17 (mixed results)
Kyriakidou Y et al. The effect of omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid supplementation on exercise-induced muscle damage. J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2021;18:9 (less soreness in some studies)

Rimm EB et al. Seafood long-chain n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids and cardiovascular disease: a science advisory from the American Heart Association. Circulation 2018;138:e35-e47 (1-2 seafood meals a week)
NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, Omega-3 fact sheet (interaction with blood thinners such as warfarin)
